barnes1968illiac.basis: Machine paper: computation mapping, communication generation and compiler/runtime say Not applicable; no distribution method and no objective stated; all lists empty

russell1978cray1.basis: Data decomposition and communication generation say Not applicable; computation mapping targets functional units of one CPU, not processors (left empty); vectorization decided before execution, card says fully-static tag covers loop decisions (pp. 63, 71)

unat2017trends.basis: Survey: hierarchical tiled arrays and DASH nested layouts (Secs. 3, 3.2), block and cyclic not classified (Sec. 7.2); task placement by environments, Chapel locales and X10 places (Secs. 2, 4.2); MPI, GPU models and X10 explicit, UPC invisible, CAF evident, Loci automatic (Secs. 4.1.1, 4.2, 4); compiler/runtime holds only survey recommendations (Secs. 5.1.1, 7.3), not coded; survey goals are terminology and trends, no objective coded
